prompt: Find the length of a string, then print it with `puts`, and return the length. Tap the line that loses the answer.
code:
mov rdi, rbx
call strlen
mov r8, rax
mov rdi, rbx
call puts
mov rax, r8
ret
explain: `r8` is caller-saved, so `puts` is free to overwrite it. Keep values that must survive a call in callee-saved registers (rbx, r12-r15) or on the stack.
